# TDM — The Digital Marketing Services

> TDM is a full-service digital agency headquartered in Dubai (UAE) with its
> delivery hub in Lahore (Pakistan) and presence in the UK, USA, Cameroon,
> Japan, France and Bulgaria. Four divisions: Media, Marketing, Development,
> and Staff Augmentation. 150+ clients served, 100% client satisfaction rate,
> 50+ specialists, delivery in English, French and Arabic. Meta Business,
> Shopify and Google partner.

Contact: info@thedigitalmarketing.services · +971 58 909 4045

## Services

- [Media](https://thedigitalmarketing.services/media/): video editing, video shoots, UGC ads, product shoots, ad creatives
- [Marketing](https://thedigitalmarketing.services/marketing/): performance marketing (Google/Meta/TikTok ads), SEO (incl. native Arabic SEO), social media management
- [Development](https://thedigitalmarketing.services/development/): Shopify, WordPress, Magento, custom platforms (Next.js, Laravel), CRM/ERP systems, mobile apps (Swift, Kotlin, Flutter/React Native)
- [Staff Augmentation](https://thedigitalmarketing.services/staff-augmentation/): dedicated remote developers, designers and marketers recruited, employed and managed by TDM in Lahore — typically 50–70% below equivalent US/UK/Gulf hiring costs

## Documented results

- [Case studies](https://thedigitalmarketing.services/case-studies/): 16× organic traffic (22K→350K sessions/mo) and 10× sustained ROAS for a UAE fragrance retailer; a 2,400-article bilingual legal platform for a Paris law practice; top-3 rankings in 6 months with 3,000+ backlinks for a UAE perfume store; +250% organic traffic in 3 months for a new business; native iOS/Android apps for ride-hailing and food delivery.
